name: Espacenet and EPO Open Patent Services (OPS)
notes: EPO fair use: Espacenet web is for humans only (10 searches/min, robots refused). Automated access via OPS REST with registration and acceptance of OPS terms; free up to 4 GB/week, about 1 Mbit/s, schedule bulk runs off-peak. Reuse governed by OPS terms (not read). Patent documents themselves are published records. Evidence: https://www.epo.org/en/service-support/ordering/fair-use
